unreadable: J10 position 3: low-resolution silkscreen, read as IO43-TX0; the last digit of IO43 is blurry (3 vs 5).
uncertain: J6, J7, J10 and the 8-pin connector: pin names are printed in a legend box beside each connector, not at each pad; pad mapping assumes the legend's left-to-right order matches the pads.
J5: VON-/VOP+ are printed in a separate box to the right of the connector; mapping VON- = left pad, VOP+ = right pad is inferred from the legend order.
8-pin connector: a 'J4' designator is printed between the small FPC P4 and this connector; it was not assigned because the image does not settle which part it belongs to.
notes: PCB render of the CrowPanel 7-inch board (ESP32 Display-7 Inch, DIS08070H, V2.0). Combined legends printed as 'IO20-SCL' etc. split into GPIO label plus function. Skipped: J3 USB-C (UART0), J1 BAT battery connector (+ mark only), J2 50-pin FPC, P2/P4 6-pin FPCs (only 1/6 marks), TF slot, BOOT/RESET buttons. The 'I2S-CTRL IO18/IO42/IO17' box near U11 describes the amplifier, not a connector.
